notes.title: 🎧Volume Control Feature Now Available!
notes.notes: [p]Thank you so much for playing the TASU Bowl demo and for taking the time to share your feedback! We're really sorry to hear that the loud audio made it hard for you to enjoy the game properly. Based on your feedback, we've released an updated version today that allows you to adjust the sound volume. We truly hope this update helps you play for more than just one minute this time! Thanks again for your support, and we hope you continue to enjoy TASU Bowl![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45591473/c8209432d4acc5906aabf733d17a6e695ff1ad5a.png"][/img][/p]
